name: obsidian-bamboo-review-dev
description: Build/test/lint toolchain for the plugin. Kept OUT of the root package.json on purpose: the Obsidian community-directory source-review scanner runs `npm ci` at the repo root and must be able to install only the minimal set the type-checked lint needs (obsidian / @types/node / typescript). Everything heavy (esbuild, jest, vitest, prettier, eslint, @typescript-eslint) lives here so the scanner never has to pull it.

scripts.dev: npm run build:webapp && npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:webapp && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:main
